description: Clear a custom field's value on a task, resetting it to empty. Returns a confirmation with the task and field ids.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true to treat `task_id` as a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires `team_id`.

field_id.description: ID of the custom field to clear.

task_id.description: ID of the task to clear the field on.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: remove_task_custom_field_value
